figurative_meaning_en: Being nurtured with care and affection
similar_in_english: living in the lap of luxury
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ছোটবেলা থেকে মামার ভাতে থেকে বড় হয়েছে, তাই এখনও আদরের অভ্যস্ত।
গ্রামের অনেক ছেলে মামার ভাতে থেকে শিক্ষা করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He grew up living on his maternal uncle's rice, so he's still used to being pampered.
Many village boys study while living on their uncle's provisions.
history: This idiom reflects the traditional Bengali cultural norm where the maternal uncle (mama) often provides generous support and pampering to his sister's children, emphasizing family bonds in rural and semi-rural settings.
note: The idiom highlights the affectionate role of the maternal uncle in Bengali society.
